label: Whatever has received esse is given being by another whenever it is present
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (concurrent actualization, strong version): in every history of the model, whatever has its esse received in some principle (DEF-ESSE-RECEIVED-IN) is, at every moment t at which it is present, given being at t (GivesAt, definition 158301bc, STRICT esse-giving reading) by something distinct from it. The distinctness clause excludes the thing's own persistence power as the factor, the form of the reply attributed to Feser 2021 (read; paragraph beginning 'But this simply ignores': if the additional factor is some other part of the thing itself, the circularity problem returns); no claim attributes this premise to him. It is not used by the derivation, which needs only the weak version; it is satisfied with different givers at different moments (Control part 3, relay), so it does not by itself give a sustaining cause. Strengthens 'Whatever has received esse is given being by something whenever it is present' (registered); an intrinsic persistence power satisfies the weak version and falsifies this one (Control part 2).
